subject: AWS Private Listing: onboarding checklist & evidence flow
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@blueforge.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lina.chen@blueforge.com
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private listing interest / next steps

Thanks Karthik — excited to move forward. A couple of asks from our side to make the AWS private listing viable:

1) Can you confirm who owns the private offer paperwork on your side and whether Redwood will sign the AWS private offer agreement or if BlueForge needs to be the primary signer?
2) We need a concise evidence bundle for our internal procurement (SOC2 summary, PII processing note, and last 12 months uptime SLA report). Can you share a single ZIP we can attach to our internal PO?
3) Are you able to provide a demo-credit code or a short trial SKU we can use for early adopter customers (3 customers, 60 days)?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — procurement has an internal deadline of May 20.

--
Sanjay Rao
Head of Product, BlueForge Analytics
https://blueforge.com
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@blueforge.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private listing interest / next steps

Sanjay — thanks, good to be aligned. Short answers and next steps below.

1) Signing: Redwood signs the AWS private offer as the seller; BlueForge will be the purchaser. Grace will own the AWS paperwork and coordinate with our legal ops.
2) Evidence bundle: attaching a packaged ZIP with SOC2 summary, PII processing one-pager, and monthly SLA excerpt (see attachment: co-sell-evidence-bundle.zip). Ben will add telemetry slides if you need more detail.
3) Demo credits / trial SKU: we can provision a limited trial SKU and three customer promo codes for 60 days. Ben — can you create the SKU and codes by EOD Thursday?

Plan:
- May 8: Redwood provides final evidence ZIP + draft SOW (attached).
- May 9–13: BlueForge procurement reviews; sign private offer by May 16 if OK.
- May 20: Early adopter customers launched under private offer.

I'll loop Grace for AWS listing steps.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 9 May 2029 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Private Listing: onboarding checklist & evidence flow

Sanjay — quick checklist for AWS private listing (what I will own + what I need from BlueForge):

My side (Redwood):
- Fill and submit AWS private listing form to AWS (I will attach the seller-signed private offer PDF).
- Provide marketplace listing assets (logo, short/long descriptions, support contact).
- Coordinate listing validation with AWS account team and confirm SKU and metering labels.

Your side (BlueForge):
- Confirm purchase entity and signing authority name + email for the private offer.
- Provide customer-facing description and any partner co-branding copy.
- Procurement to confirm SLAs are acceptable (we included the 99.9% monthly uptime excerpt in the ZIP).

Deadline: please send the purchasing authority and final description by May 13 so I can submit to AWS on May 14. Once AWS approves (typically 3–5 business days), we can set effective date on private offer.

Also, I included a short SOW draft (SOW_v1_BlueForge.docx) in case you want to anchor professional services in the private offer.

Grace O'Connor
Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@blueforge.com>

Thanks everyone — update from procurement:

- Purchasing authority confirmed: BlueForge, Inc. signed by Priya Malhotra (CPO) — priya.malhotra@blueforge.com.
- Description for listing attached below (paste): "BlueForge Analytics — real-time insights powered by Redwood Inference; private-offer trial for early adopters."
- We received the evidence ZIP and internal counsel flagged one minor data residency clarifier; Lina will follow up separately with the specific language we need added to the PII note (expected by EOD Thursday).

We are good to proceed with Grace submitting to AWS on May 14 per your timeline. Please go ahead and trigger the staging link and send the demo codes to our pilot customers once listing is approved.

Appreciate the speed on this.
